properties.bedrock_formation: Crag and Tail volcanic plug (olivine basalt) overlain by Carboniferous sedimentary sandstones and shales of the Ballagan Formation
properties.topsoil: Urban modified anthrosol over compacted glacial till and dense silty clays
properties.drainage: Steep north-to-south runoff draining down the Royal Mile spine toward the Cowgate gorge

structures.facade_material: Craigleith ashlar and dressed blonde/buff Carboniferous sandstone with soot patina
structures.roof_material: Scotch slate with lead flashing, crow-stepped gables, and heavy stone chimney stacks

structures.facade_material: Harled and coursed rubble sandstone masonry
structures.roof_material: Pitched Scottish slate with zinc ridges

structures.facade_material: Fine-tooled Scottish blonde sandstone with decorative corbelling and oriel window projections
structures.roof_material: Slate mansard with glazed skylights and lead roll seams

properties.paving_and_ground: Granite sett paving with smooth Caithness flagstone pedestrian sidewalks and cut-stone kerbs

properties.solar_illumination: Crisp Scottish afternoon light piercing through high cloud cover, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the Royal Mile pavement
properties.acoustic_texture: Low resonant rumble of vehicle traffic over granite setts, footsteps echoing between high canyon-like tenement walls, wind shearing off the Castlehill ridge
properties.olfactory_notes: Damp stone, aged wood, faint chimney peat soot, cold North Sea maritime air
